two classes consistently on every trial it produces: the trial that used to be drawn with gap 0
and label 1 is now drawn with gap 0 and label 0, and vice versa. Neither the feature vector for a
given draw of the random stream nor the partition of trials into two groups changes; only the u32
attached to each group does. `NearestCentroid` accumulates a centroid per label and predicts the
nearest, so swapping the two labels swaps the two centroids and swaps every prediction with it,
and `metrics::accuracy` compares prediction against truth — both swapped — giving the identical
number. The bounds on `ea`, `la`, `blind`, `reliability()` and the early/late gap are therefore
bit-for-bit unchanged, and the one assertion that is not a pure accuracy, the count of trials
predicted class 1, is bounded symmetrically at one fifth and four fifths of the test set.
